checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Compare decoded IK FK TCP with the demonstrated commanded TCP after subtracting and restoring the identical causal anchor translation. World rotation-6D is projected only by stable Gram-Schmidt; IK convergence, residuals and limit contacts are reported.

contract.cut_relation: Supervises every action in all twelve assigned [start,stop) segments, including the full approximately 230-240 action place_blue overlap covering blue lower/open, retreat, transit, red acquisition and initial lift. No action or terminal responsibility is trimmed.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is [world-axis TCP position minus the causally selected anchor translation in metres, world TCP rotation-6D, native gripper scalar]. The selected anchor is blue_pose during nearest-blue predecessor handling, red_pose during nearest-red source acquisition before lift, and observed red_goal after red is lifted over 0.05 m above goal z or is within 0.12 m horizontally of goal. Decode resolves this rule from the fresh observation, adds the fresh anchor translation, projects 6D to SO(3), and uses supplied Panda IK from freshly measured qpos. Slot 0 represents t-1; execution uses slots 1..8 beginning at t. Gripper sign semantics are unchanged.
contract.parameter_semantics: target_object selects observed red_pose for source-side translation anchoring; destination selects observed red_goal in world metres for lifted transport, placement and retreat; handoff_object selects observed blue_pose and blue_goal for predecessor context. These are semantic scene identifiers, not actuator parameters. The fixed causal anchor rule uses destination if red is more than 0.05 m above destination z or within 0.12 m horizontally of destination, otherwise whichever of blue or red is nearer the TCP.
